title: When Children Die
author: Russell M. Nelson
source_file: epub/!Ready/Gateway We Call Death - Russell M Nelson.epub
note: 1992 Deseret Book. Nelson's treatise on death and mourning, combining his cardiac-surgeon medical perspective with apostolic teaching. Written 8 years into his Q12 ministry (called April 1984 by Spencer W. Kimball). First Nelson-as-author work in the corpus; prior Nelson content limited to his conference talks and the Teachings of Presidents manual.
